title: Garin: Sara Duterte's defense witnesses strengthened case against her

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Deputy Speaker Janette L. Garin of Iloilo said on Saturday that defense witnesses in the proceedings against Vice President Sara Duterte have inadvertently strengthened the prosecution’s case. Speaking at the Saturday News Forum at Dapo Restaurant in Quezon City, Garin argued that testimonies presented during the first week of the defense’s presentation produced answers favorable to the prosecution. “The defense witnesses were actually able to strengthen [the case],” Garin said.
